title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming parity + ergonomics (v1.122.0)
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: v1.122.0: Unify auth behavior across SDKs, align retry/backoff defaults, add streaming parity and ergonomic wrappers for stream consumption; includes TS/Go/Python examples and docs updates.
description: Motivation: Bring parity across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs for auth handling, retry/backoff, and streaming ergonomics to reduce customer confusion and enable consistent application behavior; this is the v1.122.0 release. Changes: 1) Auth: centralize token refresh and header handling in shared middleware to ensure identical behavior across SDKs; support token rotation without impacting inflight streams. 2) Retries: standardize idempotent vs non-idempotent retry policies, default backoff to jittered exponential with max_attempts=3, expose RetryPolicy config in all languages. 3) Streaming: add ergonomics wrappers for streaming responses (async iterators in Python/TS, channel-based API in Go), fix edge cases for cancelation and partial messages, and ensure function-calling events are surfaced consistently. 4) Docs/examples: add quickstarts for streaming and auth rotation. Checklist: - [x] API parity tests for auth/retries/streaming - [x] Updated SDK docs and changelogs - [x] Unit/integration tests across runtimes - [x] Bumped package versions to v1.122.0 Commits summary: feat(py): central auth middleware and token refresher; feat(ts): streaming async iterator wrapper + retry config; feat(go): channel-based stream consumer + retry package; fix: handle stream cancelation on auth refresh; chore: bump versions and update changelogs. Files touched (high level): sdks/python/redwood_sdk/auth.py; sdks/python/redwood_sdk/retries.py; sdks/python/redwood_sdk/streaming.py; sdks/ts/src/auth/*; sdks/ts/src/streaming/*; sdks/go/auth/*; sdks/go/streaming/*; docs/quickstarts/streaming.md; CHANGELOG.md; package.json (ts); setup.cfg (py); go.mod. Review convo summary: Initial review requested clearer RetryPolicy defaults and more tests for non-idempotent calls; Marco asked to expose RetryPolicy config in public ctor for all SDKs; Dina requested coverage for network partition streaming cancel; author responded with tests and API tweak to expose RetryPolicy and stream Cancel() semantics; Ethan requested small TypeScript naming change which was applied. CI: all checks passed after one rerun (flake in python lint fixed); integration matrix showed identical behavior for simulated token rotation and stream cancel flow. Merge: merged via squash on 2025-11-10 after approvals from Marco and Dina. Notes: No breaking changes expected, but we called out clients that depended on previous implicit retry behavior to review their configs.
merge_details: merged via squash on 2025-11-10; approvals: Marco Li, Dina Park; merge_commit: 'squash: sdks unify auth/retries/streaming parity (v1.122.0)'
